If you want to undo or reject the changes, here are your options:

1. If you haven't merged the changes yet, simply don't merge them and delete the branch:
```bash
# Switch back to main branch
git checkout main

# Delete the local branch
git branch -d refactor-aside

# Delete the remote branch
git push origin --delete refactor-aside
```

2. If you've already merged the changes and want to revert them:
```bash
# Create a revert commit
git revert <commit-hash>

# Push the revert
git push origin main
```

3. If you want to keep some changes but not others, you could:
- Create a new branch from main
- Cherry-pick only the commits you want to keep
- Make your own modifications
- Create a new PR with your preferred version
